query:
SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(s.scope::text) FILTER (WHERE s.scope IS NOT NULL),
                           ARRAY[]::text[]) AS "scopes!"
             FROM grants g
             LEFT JOIN grant_scopes s ON s.grant_id = g.id
            WHERE g.application_id = $1 AND g.guild_id = $2
            GROUP BY g.id
